title: Unknotting Problem
exact_target: Can a classical algorithm decide whether any given knot diagram is an unknot in time bounded by a fixed polynomial in the input length?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1484 (TOP-006). CC BY 4.0.

Joel Hass, Jeffrey C. Lagarias and Nicholas Pippenger, \emph{The Computational Complexity of Knot and Link Problems}, Journal of the ACM 46 (1999), 185--211; arXiv:math/9807016, Sections 1 and 3, knot diagrams and their input length.
